definitions.explanation: A domesticated ruminant animal kept for its wool and meat. Counter: {匹|ひき} or {頭|とう}.

examples.japanese: {羊|ひつじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毛|け}→毛：01392_ke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Make a sweater from sheep's wool.

examples.japanese: {羊|ひつじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}く→眠い：00872_nemui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: They say counting sheep makes you sleepy.

examples.japanese: {羊|ひつじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Sheep are animals that move in flocks.
I hear that in spring they shear the sheep at the ranch and spin the wool into yarn to sell.

notes:
{羊|ひつじ} refers to sheep, a domesticated animal raised for wool and meat.

COUNTERS:
- ⟦{一匹|いっぴき}→一匹：08930_ippiki⟧, ⟦{二匹|にひき}→匹：00939_hiki⟧... (small animals)
- ⟦{一頭|いっとう}→頭：18067_tou⟧, ⟦{二頭|にとう}→頭：18067_tou⟧... (larger animals, formal)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{羊毛|ようもう}→羊毛：20649_youmou⟧: wool
- ⟦{羊肉|ようにく}→羊肉：30426_youniku⟧: mutton/lamb (meat)
- ラム: lamb (meat, from English)
- ⟦{牧羊|ぼくよう}→牧羊：noentry⟧: sheep farming

ZODIAC:
One of the twelve zodiac animals. Written as ⟦{未|ひつじ}→未：noentry⟧ in zodiac context (⟦{未年|ひつじどし}→未年：noentry⟧ - Year of the Sheep).

EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{迷|まよ}える→迷う：02426_mayou⟧{羊|ひつじ}: lost sheep (metaphor for lost/confused person)
- {羊|ひつじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧: to count sheep (to fall asleep)
